    AI Overview
    The 2026 Masters Tournament features a record-breaking $22.5 million total purse, with the winner taking home a historic $4.5 million. This marks a significant increase from the $21 million purse in 2025. The runner-up earns $2,430,000, while the third-place finisher receives $1,530,000, with top-12 finishers earning at least $517,500. 
    2026 Masters Payout Breakdown (Top 10) 
    • 1st: $4,500,000
    • 2nd: $2,430,000
    • 3rd: $1,530,000
    • 4th: $1,080,000
    • 5th: $900,000
    • 6th: $810,000
    • 7th: $753,750
    • 8th: $697,500
    • 9th: $652,500
    • 10th: $607,500 
    Key Payout Details 
    • Winner's Prize: The $4.5 million winner's check continues a trend of rising payouts at Augusta National, nearly tripling the winner's share from just a few years prior.
    • Cut Line: Players who make the cut (top 50 and ties) are guaranteed significant prize money, while professionals missing the cut receive $25,000 each.
    • Amateurs: Amateur players do not receive monetary prizes.
    • Perks: In addition to the cash, the winner receives a lifetime exemption to the Masters and a gold medal.
